solution.title: Microsoft Teams Security & Compliance — Information Barriers, Retention & DLP

products.name: Microsoft Teams Security & Compliance — Information Barriers, Retention & DLP — Commercial
products.short_description: Apply the Teams-specific security & compliance controls — information barriers, Teams chat/channel retention, and Teams DLP — scoped to Teams and aligned to your Purview program. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Apply the Teams-specific security and compliance controls

Teams carries chats, channel messages, and files that need compliance controls — and the Teams-specific ones are easy to miss. This solution applies Teams security & compliance: information barriers (segment groups that can't communicate), Teams retention policies (chat/channel), Teams DLP, and communication-compliance touchpoints — scoped to what's specific to Teams, referencing the broader Purview program rather than duplicating it.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the Teams-specific controls: information barriers, Teams retention (chat/channel), Teams DLP, and how they relate to the org-wide Purview program.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites with how to verify/implement (compliance licensing, roles, existing Purview retention/DLP posture, compliance stakeholders).
  • Implementation Guide — define + apply information-barrier policies (segments/associations), set Teams chat/channel retention, configure Teams DLP, and validate — pilot-first, each policy named; records/legal determinations deferred to compliance.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic MicrosoftTeams PowerShell / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (barriers enforced, retention applied, DLP effective in Teams) plus Best Practices; broader DLP/labels handled by the Purview program.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Teams brought under compliance — information barriers enforced, chat/channel retention applied, Teams DLP effective — the Teams-specific controls closed, aligned to Purview.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • TEAMSCOMP-Assessment.ps1 — Read-only assessment of the Teams-specific compliance posture (information barriers, Teams retention, Teams DLP)
    • TEAMSCOMP-Configure-InformationBarriers.ps1 — Information-barrier segment + policy config helper (dry-run / -WhatIf by default; writes only with -Commit)
    • TEAMSCOMP-Configure-RetentionDlp.ps1 — Teams retention + Teams DLP config helper (dry-run / -WhatIf by default; writes only with -Commit)
    • TEAMSCOMP-ScopeHelper.ps1 — Scope / health helper (read-only): previews IB segment scope and checks IB prerequisites before application
    • TEAMSCOMP-Validation.ps1 — Compliance-control validation report (read-only): checks the expected named artifacts and states

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
